alternatives.reason: Gate details, reasons, impacts and evidence text are produced by the Go services as technical detail and stay English in both locales; only static workspace copy is localised. A message catalogue on the server side would be a separate slice.
UI-18 requires the raw code to stay retrievable; the badge shows the human label and the code side by side, and every existing browser assertion on codes keeps holding.
UI-15 requires refresh, back and reopen to restore the same Project without mixing state; the Project id now lives in the URL (/projects/{id}) and the SPA fallback serves it.

architecture_impact: frontend/src/i18n: LocaleProvider + useLocale with t(message, values) — the English string is the key, zh-TW is looked up in a dictionary, missing entries fall back to English; the locale persists in localStorage (context-rail.locale) and sets <html lang>. Data values (Project names, paths, ids, commits, digests, refs, user input) never pass through t().

StatusBadge renders a human label per locale for known machine status codes and keeps the code visible as <code class=status-code> with title/data-code; identifiers (RR-001, DEC-001) and unknown codes render verbatim.

App binds the selected Project to /projects/{id} (replaceState on first load, pushState on selection, popstate restores); a deep link to a configured Project wins over the first Project; unknown ids fall back to the first Project.

Every static copy in App, ProjectRegistry, WorkspaceState, ProjectContextPage, ReadinessSummary, DocumentStatusList, EnvironmentTopology, ChangesPanel, CandidateReview, ReleasesPanel and DocumentsPanel goes through t(); a unit test scans the sources and fails when a t() key lacks a zh-TW entry.
Server-generated text (gate details, reasons, impacts, advisor unknowns) stays English as technical detail in both locales.
unknowns: Server-generated details are not localised; the UI-16 wording about mixed copy is met for static copy and deferred for machine details.
Only zh-TW and en exist; adding a locale means adding a dictionary and a status label map.
acceptance_criteria: UI-15: refresh keeps the Project and its topology version; switching Projects changes the URL and shows only that Project's ledger; back restores the previous Project; a deep link opens the named Project.
UI-16: switching to zh-TW changes headings, buttons, labels and notes; no English static copy remains (unit test over every t() key).
UI-17: after refresh the locale and the Project context are unchanged; switching Projects keeps the locale.
UI-18: badges show the human label and the machine code together in both locales.
UI-19: Project name, source root, repo paths, ids, target refs and user-entered titles read back unchanged in zh-TW and after switching back to en.

human_decision.reason: Owner chose to build every non-GCP slice now ("都做"). Accepts the workspace locale and persistence slice as local development/testing.
